build.beforeDevCommand: bun run --cwd ../../packages/daemon build && bun run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: bun run --cwd ../../packages/daemon build && bun run build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; frame-src http: https:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost ws://127.0.0.1:*; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:
